description: Election Commission - P. S. K. A. Shanjith was Selected the member of the Gampaha Pradeshiya Sabha - W. Palihakkara was Selected the member of the Matara Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Gampaha Pradeshiya Sabha and Matara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to member deaths, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including party nominations and declarations of elected members, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than general government personnel changes.
